board.task: THE CLEVERER PATHS — second panel pass on #31 (founder: 'aren't there even more clever ways?'). Six that survived scrutiny, ranked by installs x cheapness x fit, all inside the canon: (a) **ASO IS THE BIGGEST UNPRICED CHANNEL** — ~65% of iOS discovery is App Store search and we have costed it at zero. Title/subtitle/keyword set against real demand ('screen time', 'journal', 'data export', 'digital wellbeing', 'quantified self'); worth thousands of free installs/month at no marginal cost. Build the keyword set + 3 subtitle variants NOW, ship with 1.0. (b) **POST-EXPORT INTENT, which nobody owns** — everyone chases 'how do I export my X data'; the higher-intent query is the one that comes AFTER the email arrives: 'what do I do with my ChatGPT export', 'how to open conversations.json', 'how to read my Instagram data download'. That person has the file in hand THIS MINUTE. One page per query, each ending at the demo. (c) **THE DELETION MOMENT** — 'take your record before you delete your account' attaches us to a mass behaviour with existing search volume (delete Instagram/Facebook/X) that REQUIRES an export first. We own the prerequisite of a thing millions already do. (d) **DECEMBER COUNTER-PROGRAMMING** — Wrapped season is the one month a year the whole internet posts artefacts about their own record. 'Wrapped for everything else', run in the browser, no install, any export. Our Sept/Oct launch lands perfectly to be ready; the First Reading (#34) IS the artefact. board.task: **THE KILL CRITERION FIRED — testers said BORING, USELESS, NOT FULLY FUNCTIONING, EMPTY. THIS OUTRANKS EVERY OTHER ITEM ON THIS BOARD INCLUDING #31.** Full diagnosis and rebuild: night_shift/THE_BORING_FIX.md. Four words = four separate failures, and only two are dangerous: 'NOT FUNCTIONING' + 'EMPTY' are engineering, already assigned (#32 TTFF, #30 connections, archive door) — days of work, least important thing they said. 'BORING' is the product: **A COUNT IS NOT A FINDING.** We read the no-verdicts law as 'only report counts', and a bare frequency about yourself is interesting for four seconds. Nobody is surprised by a number about themselves; they are surprised by a CONTRADICTION. The canon forbids interpretation — it does NOT forbid CONTRAST. 'USELESS' means nothing changes because they read it — no job done. **THE REBUILD — THE CONTRADICTION ENGINE. The unit of value changes from `finding` to `gap`.** A gap has four evidenced, uninterpreted parts: the CLAIM (something they actually said/wrote/scheduled, quoted and dated from their own record), the RECORD (what the counting shows happened instead), the DISTANCE (stated numerically), the RECEIPTS (dated rows behind both sides, tappable). Example, canon-legal and not boring: 'You said you would call your mother every week. You called nine times in six months.' Two counts side by side; no verdict; nothing interpreted. GAP FAMILIES IN BUILD ORDER: (1) SAID vs DID from reminders + calendar ALONE — highest hit rate, needs NO export, therefore it fixes 'empty' in the same stroke; (2) THEN vs NOW (a year ago's words against today's); (3) WORDS vs HOURS; (4) DECLARED vs REPEATED. Register law unchanged: state both counts and STOP — never why, never advice; care floor still outranks everything and holds any gap touching grief, health or harm. WHY IT ALSO FIXES 'USELESS': a gap implies a next move without prescribing one, and it creates the missing loop — the person can now make a claim ON PURPOSE and be graded on a date (the wager book). It is also the first thing anyone would post: a gap shares itself, where trivia never did. RE-TEST: the SAME ten people, same protocol, same silence, same single question. They have seen the boring version, which makes them the harshest possible audience and the only 'oh' worth anything. COST, stated honestly: 2-4 weeks and the aggressive September band. CORRECT TRADE — launching the boring version gets the same four words from strangers at a price we cannot recover (one-shot moments spent, first impressions burned).
